sections.title: Before reading: study Chapter 4 in How to read. The sheet is across the river.

segments.text: 日出。安在門外，持紙。父視紙，見「安」字。紙有名，無姓。先生出門，安還紙，先生取紙。先生持卷，持紙。
寧還二葉，主人取二葉。父持二葉，視子。母持小書出門。客閉帙。使者持大書，持帙。母視安，視寧。母持小書入門。先生入門。父持二葉入門。父閉門。
客行，安行。寧去，至川。安見川，止。紙在東岸，安在西岸。寧視紙，客至川。川有水，有橋。北橋近，南橋遠。寧至北橋，視路。橋在水中，路在水中。

inference_aids.alt: A sheet lies across a river.
inference_aids.art_brief: At the river: An and Ning on west bank, messenger carrying large book and wrapper; separate sheet on east bank, north bridge/path under water. No original An sheet or parents present.

segments.text: 安至北橋，止。客視水，持帙。海在北，山在南。安視海，寧待安。客視東岸，紙在東岸。寧還，至西岸。寧視南橋，安去。寧在岸，安至北橋。客立，視安。安視水，還。寧待安，客待寧。

exercises.title: Locate a person or thing
exercises.instruction: Different complete miniature incidents, not current story facts. Type the Chinese form selected by each numbered meaning and citation reading. Story arrows point to an earlier form or pattern, not the new incident. Cues: 1: mother is on a bank; location predicate zài; 2: father is at a bridge; zài; 3: teacher is at a river; zài; 4: a sheet is on a mountain; zài; 5: a child is outside a gate; zài.

obrazec.rule: Place 在 after the named subject and before the place. This states location, not possession.

exercises.instruction: Different complete miniature incidents, not current story facts. Type the Chinese form selected by each numbered meaning and citation reading. obrazec.rule: Use the whole bounded label; the direction precedes the place noun.

sections.title: The near crossing fails; the distant route takes time.

segments.text: 安至海，見水。海無橋，安止。客至海，視水。客還，安還。寧在西岸，待安。安至川，見寧。客至川，寧立。
寧：「北橋在水中。南橋在南。」
segments.speaker: char-ning

segments.text: 寧行，安視南。山在南，路在南。安至路，客行。
客持帙，寧視山。安行，至山。山近，南橋遠。寧至山，待客。客至山，安坐。寧待安。安遲，客止。寧去，至橋。客行，至橋。安在山，視日。
寧在橋，安在山。客還，至山。客待安，寧待客。安立，視日。
寧在南橋，視川。南橋有路。寧渡川，至東岸。客至南橋，待安。安至橋，客渡川。寧在東岸，待安。安渡川，至東岸。安視日，止。客視紙，行。

inference_aids.alt: The travellers take the southern crossing.
inference_aids.art_brief: Southern bridge: Ning has crossed to east bank, An and messenger still approach from west bank; messenger retains large book and wrapper. No unseen crossing.

exercises.title: Location and possession do different work
exercises.instruction: Different complete miniature incidents, not current story facts. Type the Chinese form selected by each numbered meaning and citation reading. obrazec.rule: The cue chooses either be at (在) or have (有). Neither form changes with its subject.

exercises.title: Reach, cross, leave and wait
exercises.instruction: Different complete miniature incidents, not current story facts. Type the Chinese form selected by each numbered meaning and citation reading. Story arrows point to an earlier form or pattern, not the new incident. Cues: 1: mother crosses the river, dù; 2: a child waits for a teacher, dài; 3: father goes away, qù; 4: An reaches a mountain, zhì; 5: teacher waits for a child, dài.

obrazec.rule: A destination follows 至; a river follows 渡. 待 names waiting for the person supplied.

sections.title: The two sheets differ; daylight ends before the journey does.

segments.text: 客至東岸，止。客持大書，取紙。紙有姓，無「安」字。客持紙，寧取紙。寧視姓，安視字。安無紙，師有紙。客視寧，寧還紙。客取紙，持紙。客開帙，安視帙。客閉帙，持紙。
紙有少字，帙字少。客視紙，視帙。安視姓，止。寧視紙，視客。
安視西岸，視北橋。北橋近，南橋遠。寧去，至南橋。客行，安行。寧渡川，客渡川。安至南橋，視日。安渡川，至西岸。
安行，寧待安。家遠，山近。客視紙，止。客遲，寧待客。寧視客，安去。安遲，寧行。日入。安見門，止。家遠，門近。門外有燈，無人。安視燈，寧視門。
燈在門外，門閉。客至門，持紙。寧在門外，待安。安至門，視燈。客視姓，安視門。安立，寧立。

inference_aids.alt: A lamp stands outside a closed gate.
inference_aids.art_brief: After sunset, a different closed gate near the travelling group, their household still far away. Lamp outside, nobody visibly holding it; An/Ning wait outside, messenger has book/wrapper/new surname sheet. No invented keeper or readable surname.

exercises.instruction: Different complete miniature incidents, not current story facts. Type the Chinese form selected by each numbered meaning and citation reading. grammar.title: 紙在東岸
grammar.rule: 紙｜在｜東岸。門外｜有｜燈。燈｜在｜門外。
grammar.note_en:
Study Chapter 4 in How to read first. It supplies seven packets, forty-two supported attempts, and worked contrasts for the bounded locations and routes. This is constructed graded narration. The letters are modern Mandarin citation readings, not reconstructed ancient pronunciation.

A location predicate says where a named person or thing is. In 紙在東岸, “the sheet is on the east bank,” 紙 is the subject being located, 在 zài is the predicate “be at,” and 東岸 is the location. Nothing is possessed by the sheet. Compare 川有水，有橋, “the river has water and bridges”: 有 states presence, rather than locating its subject. 門外有燈, “there is a lamp outside the gate,” presents a lamp at a named site; 燈在門外, “the lamp is outside the gate,” starts with the lamp and locates it. The different order selects what the sentence tells us about. Do not replace 在 with 有 merely because English sometimes uses “there is.”

The direction labels 東岸 dōng àn, east bank, 西岸 xī àn, west bank, 北橋 běi qiáo, north bridge, and 南橋 nán qiáo, south bridge, are finite taught combinations: the direction precedes the bank or bridge. In 海在北，山在南, “the sea is to the north and the mountain to the south,” the direction itself names a place after 在. These are descriptions of the local scene, not a map of all China. The house belongs to neither a named historical site nor an inferred geography.

The two bounded expressions 水中 shuǐ zhōng, “in the water,” and 門外 mén wài, “outside the gate,” put the location element after the thing that gives its reference. Their order differs from the direction-before-place labels. 中 selects the inside/in sense here, with reading zhōng; no other reading or general noun-plus-location system is taught. 外 is restricted to the gate expression for now. 橋在水中 and 路在水中 mean that water covers the near crossing and its path. They explain the stopping and retreat; the characters never cross that bridge. Later lessons broaden the location system.

近 jìn and 遠 yuǎn can be predicates without an added verb “is”: 北橋近，南橋遠 means “the north bridge is near; the south bridge is far away.” This is distance from the travelling group, not bridge length. 安遲, “An is late,” is followed by waiting; 遲 chí is not a licence for a general adverb meaning slowly. 家遠 locates the family household back at home as far away. A newly encountered near gate does not become their household’s own gate. Its popup keeps that referent explicit.

去 qù means go away, whereas 至 zhì introduces the place reached: 安去 leaves the point of departure; 安至海 reaches the sea. 還 huán without a returned object is going back; 安還紙 gives a sheet back. 渡川 dù chuān crosses the river, and 至東岸 makes arrival on the east bank explicit. Never infer a crossing from somebody else’s position. At the southern bridge, each traveller’s crossing is on the page, both outbound and returning.

日 rì selects the sun here. The supported expressions 日出 rì chū, “the sun rises,” and 日入 rì rù, “the sun sets,” mark the daylight consumed by the longer journey. They do not license every time or daily use of 日, or every new figurative use of 出 and 入. The later chapter retains their practice. 日 is not a lamp: 燈 dēng names the separate lamp eventually seen at the new gate.

Track two sheets. An gives the earlier sheet bearing 安 back to the teacher before leaving. The recovered sheet across the river bears a surname and lacks that graph. The visitor’s 得紙, “Found the paper,” is his attributed report; no unknown surname is read aloud and no ultimate owner is proved. The large book and wrapper remain with him, while the small book, two old leaves and An’s named sheet remain with the household and teacher. The final gate is encountered while that household is still far away. The first view shows a lamp and no person at the gate; then the travellers approach it. By the end they are outside it, so the exterior is occupied. No keeper has yet been identified. 門閉 means “the gate is closed”: compare the inherited state 門開, “the gate is open,” with the action 父閉門, “the father closes the gate.” The preparation teaches and separately accounts for this bounded closed-state use before reading. No general passive system is introduced.

tables.caption: Read across: what is located, the predicate, the location
Presence at a site and location of an identified object
Directions before a place label; the spatial elements after their reference

A.title: Pensa A — Identify the relation and location

obrazec.rule: Read the named relation before selecting the predicate. No copula is added. Numbered cues: 1: teacher is on a mountain, zài; 2: mother has a loose sheet, yǒu; 3: father is on a bank, zài; 4: Ning has a fascicle, yǒu.
Complete the location selected by the cue. These are different miniature incidents. Numbered cues: 1: east bank, dōng àn; 2: outside the gate, wài; 3: in the water, zhōng; 4: north bridge, běi qiáo.

B.title: Pensa B — Select the named place or object; three nouns extra

obrazec.rule: Use the exact studied noun selected by the meaning and citation reading; no inflection. All other bank nouns were checked against each complete cue. Numbered cues: 1: river, chuān; 2: bank, àn; 3: mountain, shān; 4: sea, hǎi; 5: bridge, qiáo; 6: road, lù; 7: lamp, dēng; 8: water, shuǐ.

C.title: Pensa C — Reconstruct the route and its evidence
C.instruction: Continue each scene cue in complete Chinese sentences from the story. Retrieve events or spatial distinctions beyond the cue. A bare name, yes/no or copied cue is insufficient. Do not invent an owner, hidden crossing, lamp keeper or surname reading.

model_answers: 先生取紙。先生持卷，持紙。
items.rubric: Retrieve the teacher taking and retaining An’s sheet. Do not identify it with the later river sheet.
Retrieve the water-covered route and/or distant southern alternative, in complete statements. Do not invent a crossing of the flooded bridge.

model_answers: 安至海。海無橋。安還，客還。
items.rubric: Recall the northern attempt reaching the sea and returning, not merely that Ning waits. No unmentioned sea crossing.
Retrieve An’s explicit crossing and arrival. The cue already states the starting contrast.

model_answers: 紙有姓，無「安」字。先生有紙，紙有「安」字。
items.rubric: Distinguish the recovered surname-bearing sheet from the earlier named An sheet left with the teacher. The recovered sheet lacks the printed An graph; do not infer its owner or read an unprinted surname.

model_answers: 門外有燈。門閉。安立，寧立。
items.rubric: Retrieve the lamp outside and/or closed-gate waiting in complete statements. No keeper is identified and nobody enters. Do not say there is no person after the travellers arrive: that observation belongs to the earlier view of the gate.

notes: Original constructed narration; no quotation, audio or generated image.
Owner-authorized 日/燈/外 timing is recorded in COURSE.md and active rows; no budget, practice or destination is reduced.
All earlier introduction blocks are preserved; new preparation is separate from narrative and full normal30+A8/B8/C6.

The earlier accused-thief noun is deliberately recalled in preparation and x3-2, not another repeated accusation in the story. Twelve chapter3 recalls appear in the revised narrative; particle也 and noun盜 receive meaning-bearing practice outside it.
New location labels and household spatial context are explicitly supported and counted in the first-use ledger; a software pass does not establish annotation completeness or retention.

Disclosed gate advisories: prior-character coverage62.8% against80%; six noun media-coverage advisories because no rendered vignette/margin meaning gloss is claimed for 北/山/川/海/西/日. Each receives explicit preparation meaning/readings and contextual popups. Planned images are not inference support; independent review must judge actual readability. Pending six continuity entries merge only after both ready verdicts.

Attempt1 cx1104-211533-8652 blocked both verdicts. Delivered numbered Pensa cues; moved empty-gate observation before approach and corrected C6; named the flooded north bridge; restored 使者 in its journey role; added review-requested bounded 門閉 state support, grammar clarification, contextual gloss and load event. Re-anchored planned scenes, expanded C pointers, narrowed 中 and reduced repeated posture choreography. Full practice and all caps retained.

Final cx1104-212719-15007: linguistic ready; pedagogical ready, all LZH04-Q1–Q4 resolved. Applied nonblocking recall documentation, early-sheet popup, C2 cue and lamp-picture-anchor refinements. Detailed gate list has eight warning entries before continuity merging, despite its summary count seven; these are six media advisories, one prior-coverage advisory and one pending merge. No shared-tool count change is needed for this content release. Full report docs/reviews/lzh-chapter-04-ready-2026-11-04.md; text_status remains draft.
